overview:
PeaLang help
usage:
  help()              list all topics
  help("match")       detailed help for a topic
available topics:
  variables, functions, control_flow, match, exceptions, async, types, list, dict, strings, stats, web, ai, modules, cli
variables:
Variables & bindings
  let x = 5          declare (immutable by convention)
  const PI = 3.14    declare a constant
  let [a,b] = pair   destructure a list/tuple
  let {name} = user  destructure a dict
match:
Pattern matching (statement and expression)
  match x {
    1 => "one",
    [a, b] => a + b,
    {"key": v} => v,
    _ => "other"
  }
  wildcard: _ , literal, list, and dict patterns supported
exceptions:
Exceptions
  throw expr                            raise a UserError with message/value
  try { ... } catch e { ... }           catch any exception
  try { ... } catch ZeroDivisionError e { ... }   typed catch
  try { ... } catch TypeError as e { ... }        typed catch with 'as'
  try { ... } catch e { ... } finally { ... }
  assert cond, "message"              assert with a custom message
  Exception kinds: PeaException, UserError, NameError, ValueError, TypeError,
                   IndexError, ZeroDivisionError, ScopeError, AssertionError,
                   AttributeError, ImportError
  Catch binding fields: e["message"], e["kind"], e["source"], e["line"],
                        e["column"], e["frames"], e["trace"]
  Runtime errors print a stack trace when raised inside functions
types:
Types (optional static layer)
  let x: Int = 5
  let y: String? = null
  let r: Result = ...
  type Point = {x: Int, y: Int}
  type Result = Ok value | Err message
  trait MyTrait   (marker interface)
  erase_types strips annotations before runtime
list:
Lists
  let xs = [1, 2, 3]
  xs[0], xs[1:], xs[-1]
  [x * 2 for x in xs if x > 1]         list comprehension
  {k: v for [k,v] in items}             dict comprehension
  len(xs), sum(xs), sorted(xs), reversed(xs)
  map(f, xs), filter(f, xs), all(xs), any(xs)
dict:
Dicts
  let d = {"a": 1, "b": 2}
  d["a"], d.get("a", default), d.has("a")
  keys(d), values(d), items(d)
  merge(d1, d2), deep_merge(d1, d2)
  get_path(d, "a.b.c", default)
strings:
Strings
  "hello" + " world"                    concat
  "{x}" inside double-quoted strings       interpolation syntax
  upper(s), lower(s), trim(s)
  split(s, sep), strip_prefix, strip_suffix
  replace(s, a, b), repeat(s, n)
  contains(s, sub), starts_with(s, p), ends_with(s, p)
  pad_start(s, width, fill), pad_end(s, width, fill)
  snake_case(s), kebab_case(s), slugify(s)
stats:
Statistics & numerics (std.stats)
  Imported as: let stats = std.stats  (or registered by default)
  Provided by the pealang.numerics module
  mean, median, stddev, corr  (see std.stats for full list)
web:
Web (std.web)
  let app = web.app()
  app.enable_cors("*")
  app.get("/path", handlerFn)
  app.post("/path", handlerFn)
  app.serve("127.0.0.1", 8080)
  web.health()  web.json(x)  web.text(s)  web.envelope(data, meta)
  web.created(x)  web.not_found(msg)  app.dispatch(method, path)
ai:
AI (std.ai)
  set_ai_key("openai", "sk-...")
  get_ai_status()
  list_ai_providers()
  run_ai_query("openai", "gpt-4", "prompt")
  CloudModel / LocalModel / AIConfig (see pea_ai module)
modules:
Modules
  import "./file.pea"              import a file
  import "./file.pea" as alias      import with alias
  export name                       re-export from a module
  Modules export their top-level bindings
cli:
CLI
  pea run FILE.pea        run a script
  pea eval -e EXPR        evaluate an expression
  pea repl                interactive REPL
  pea serve FILE.pea      serve as an HTTP app
  pea scaffold fastapi ./dir   generate a service skeleton
  pea doctor              environment diagnostics
  pea info                version + available namespaces
  pea --help              command list
